title: Hofmann, Grof and Ruck's reported plan for a new Eleusis

tellings.quote: think you know Albert Hoffman who discovered LSD Stannislav Grath and Carl Ruck >> all maybe this is a rumor but I think they wanted to create a new elusis and

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Albert Hofmann, the chemist who discovered LSD, the psychiatrist Stanislav Grof and the classics scholar Carl Ruck may have wanted to create a new Eleusis, a modern version of the secret religious rite of ancient Greece that some believe used a mind-altering drink. Michels himself says this may be only a rumour, but if true it would show leading figures hoping to revive a ritual for reaching other realms.
